name: AdsPower
rootCause: The AdsPower security team discovered a breach in which hackers distributed malicious code, resulting in the compromise of some third-party browser extensions.

descriptions.text: The AdsPower security team discovered a breach in which hackers distributed malicious code, resulting in the compromise of some third-party browser extensions.

In January 2025, the distribution channel for AdsPower's antidetect browser was compromised, resulting in malicious wallet extensions stealing private keys and draining wallets. Estimated losses were between $4.1M and $4.7M across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Base. The AdsPower supply chain was breached, allowing attackers to replace legitimate crypto wallet extension files with malicious versions that extracted mnemonic phrases and private keys. Users who downloaded or updated wallet plugins between January 21 and 24, 2025, were affected.
